sfxPolicy: No whooshes, risers, impacts or pops on cuts or graphics. Speech drives timing. Only optional sparkle: paired ~8.36 kHz pings 300 ms apart on three reveals.

ping8k.confidence: medium (spectrogram only; needs a listening check)

do: Use IBM Plex Sans Arabic only, in two weights: 700 for heroes and pill lines, 200 for support lines (300 only for the tiny dark CTA subtitle).
Keep the hero 1.5-1.9x the support line; the payoff word is 156-163 px at 720 (234-245 px at 1080).
Type every caption glyph by glyph (blur 12->0 px, opacity 0->1, 100-167 ms per glyph, 25-67 ms stagger) with live reflow and a 400 ms tracking settle.
Default fill is flat #FFFFFF with no stroke or shadow; give exactly one word per section a special material (gold gradient, hot-yellow flash, orange 3D, ice chrome).
Stretch thin words with repeated tatweel so stacked thin words match widths; let one long kashida (up to 44% W) become a rule into an illustration.
Max 3 words per line, 2-4 lines per card, lines broken by meaning (hero / complement / pill line 1 / pill line 2).
Wide shots: text in the top band (9-26.5% H) above the head. MCU shots: text on the chest band (46-77% H) over the dark shirt.
Glass UI in front of the talent: stadium radius = height/2, 1.5 px white rim at 35-60% brightest on top, 4.5-9 px backdrop blur, clear / smoked 30% / orange-frosted fills.
Every capsule carries a round button: dark disc + thin glass ring + 4.5 px lime/yellow ring + arrow.
Open each new beat shot with the 138%->100% punch-out settle (567 ms, cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0.1,1)); start captions 1-6 frames after the cut.
Alternate wide and MCU strictly; alternate AI world plates (with props in front of and behind the talent) and the plain orange studio.
Cut only in VO pauses, 0-300 ms before the next phrase.
Use the B&W focus-pull interrupt once, for the 'not just X' contrast, then a 2.7 s clean MCU breather before the payoff.
End on a static 1.27 s hold of the payoff word with the CTA capsule and lens rings still on screen.
Grade: crushed blacks (p0.5 luma <=10), saturated red-orange backdrop (hue 16-24 deg), natural skin, teal wardrobe; teal/cyan reserved for props and the payoff glow.
dont: Don't use Arabic weights 400-600, strokes, drop shadows on studio captions, or more than one accent colour per section.
Don't put text over the face (MCU 17-40% H, wide 27-38% H) or below 77% H.
Don't animate captions out except the reverse type-off inside a static closing shot; everything else leaves on a hard cut.
Don't add whooshes, risers, impacts, pops, flashes, light leaks, glitches, dissolves, whip pans or speed ramps.
Don't beat-sync cuts or reveals to the music; sync to speech.
Don't apply the vignette to bright AI-plate shots or to captions.
Don't loop anything faster than ~0.5 Hz; ambient motion is slow (molecule 6.9 deg/s, fog drift, wobble ~1.5 s period).
Don't add a logo end card or fade to black.
Don't scale captions with the camera settle; only the plate and talent move.
Don't use blue/purple accents; the only cold colour is teal/cyan.
